resources.string: When a call ends
Keep the recording
Ask me: keep or delete
Every recording is kept, as always.
After each recorded call, a notification asks whether to keep it. Until you answer, it is not copied to Drive or transcribed automatically.
Asking needs notifications from CallVault. Allow them and Ask switches on.
How to ask
Notification
Pop-up over the screen
A notification with Keep and Delete.
A small window over whatever is on screen. If it can’t show (the phone is locked) or you close it without answering, a notification asks instead. Needs permission to display over other apps.
The pop-up needs permission to display over other apps. Until it is allowed, the notification asks.
If I don\'t answer
Keep it
Delete it after 24 hours
After 24 hours the recording is kept, copied and transcribed as usual.
24 hours after the call, the recording is deleted.
A recording you starred, marked, tagged, noted or transcribed is always kept.
Ask me whether to keep each recording
When a call ends, keep or delete its recording with one tap. Off keeps every recording.
